caption.text: After getting 50+ messages a day asking how we moved to CR,  I recorded a 10 minute video explaining exactly how we did it. Posted on YT @joefelz. I hope you all find your free, just like me 🇺🇸✌️🇨🇷 #joefelz #costarica #expatlife

Last week I did a thing- hired my first employee in a foreign country. Hiring someone *properly* in Costa Rica is a process, involving a lawyer, a contract, insurance premiums & employer taxes. 

I could have done it quicker & cheaper it under the table, but wanted to handle all this properly so José would have medical insurance & qualify for a pension after enough time. 

José was referred to me as one of the best agricultural minds in this area with intimate knowledge of plant cultivation & animal husbandry. And after he whipped up a garden, tamed 4 acres of overgrown finca & manicured an entire grove of plantains in one week, I sure believe it. I am humbled by both his knowledge & work ethic. 

Given that he knows way more than me, José is basically his own boss. He tells me what we’re gonna do & I listen, not the other way around. He also told me this is his DREAM JOB- his last bosses had a literal overseer who watched all workers all 8 hours daily. He is also super eager to learn solar and construction skills from me on the job. 

After a lifetime of business, this feels like a bucket list item for me. Can’t wait to see what José cooks up here at @buildingrealitycr 🇨🇷🤝❤️ #joefelz #costarica #lifegoals #dreamjob #businessman
Disregarding solid advice, we have in fact been chasin’ waterfalls 🇨🇷🌊💗 #joefelz #waterfalls #puravida #newfriends

The parts of homesteading nobody talks about….

My favorite cat, Lucifer, ended up having her litter way too early- we noticed this morning when she came to say hi that her abdomen was no longer full of kittens

Stevie, (our border collie/aussie) tracked the babies for us and find them in a secluded bush of ginger

IT GETS WORSE…I’ll spare you the video 

I took the two littles and placed them by a rock at the back of the property so that I could bury them and went to grab a shovel. Came back to LUCIFER EATING HER OWN KITTENS

Nature is raw dude

Next stop is the spay clinic

Pray for me as I try to sleep/eat with these images burned in my mind😫🐈‍⬛❤️‍🩹#buildingreality #NatureIsBrutal #kittens #homesteading #WhyGod
